C0385.title: Chengdu Qingyang Police Dismantle Small-Loan Fraud Ring Preparing to Abscond with Funds
C0385.summary: In March 2026, Chengdu Qingyang police dismantled a criminal gang that committed fraud under the guise of small loans. The group used lead generation, sales negotiation, and follow-up calls, promising 'no credit-check limits' and '100% approval' while collecting upfront fees, defrauding more than 30 victims of about 2 million yuan. Police assessed that the company might abscond with the money in March 2026, and during the operation seized fraud scripts, contracts, and other evidence while tracing the case upstream to a telemarketing company.
